title: TICKET-036-WS7 — Qwen 3.6-Plus API: ClawRouter CLOUD-EXECUTION Tier
description: TICKET-036 Workstream 7: Wire Qwen 3.6-Plus API as CLOUD-EXECUTION tier in ClawRouter. Split CLOUD into CLOUD-ORCHESTRATION (Claude Sonnet) and CLOUD-EXECUTION (Qwen 3.6-Plus). 10x cheaper for coding tasks, 1M context window. Source: TICKET-036 WS7.

tasks.title: Add CLOUD-EXECUTION tier to ClawRouter v2 config
tasks.context:
In scripts/lib/clawrouter-v2.ts, add a new CLOUD-EXECUTION tier between the existing CLOUD and APEX tiers.

Changes needed:
1. Add 'CLOUD-EXECUTION' to the tier enum/type (alongside NANO, LOCAL, POWER, CLOUD, APEX)
2. Rename existing 'CLOUD' to 'CLOUD-ORCHESTRATION' in the tier definitions
3. Add routing config for CLOUD-EXECUTION:
   - model: 'qwen-plus-latest' (Alibaba Cloud Model Studio model ID)
   - provider: 'qwen-api'
   - base_url: process.env.QWEN_API_URL || 'https://dashscope-intl.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1'
   - api_key: process.env.QWEN_API_KEY
   - max_tokens: 8192
   - temperature: 0.7
4. Add routing logic: tasks with type 'code_generation', 'agentic_coding', 'repo_engineering', or 'bulk_dev' route to CLOUD-EXECUTION. Everything else stays CLOUD-ORCHESTRATION.
5. Add new env vars to the config loader: QWEN_API_KEY, QWEN_API_URL
6. Vault rule: CLOUD-EXECUTION must NEVER receive sensitive operations (acp_scoring, codebook, financial_reasoning, pact_credentials)

Preserve all existing routing logic. This is an ADDITIVE change — no existing routes should break.

tasks.title: Create Qwen 3.6-Plus API benchmark script
tasks.deferred_reason: FP-007: qwen3:14b destructively rewrites large new files. Requires T3 (Claude Sonnet) manual rewrite. Deferred 2026-04-04.
tasks.context:
Create scripts/benchmarks/qwen36plus-benchmark.ts that benchmarks Qwen 3.6-Plus API against Claude Sonnet on 3 coding tasks.

The script should:
1. Use OpenAI-compatible API format for Qwen (base URL from env: QWEN_API_URL or default to dashscope-intl.aliyuncs.com)
2. Run 3 benchmark tasks:
   a. REPO-LEVEL: Given a codebase context (~10K tokens), implement a new feature with tests. Compare code quality.
   b. DEBUG: Given a buggy Python module with test failures, fix all bugs. Compare fix accuracy.
   c. STRUCTURED OUTPUT: Generate a PACT offer JSON schema from natural language spec. Compare schema compliance.
3. For each task, measure: latency_ms, output_tokens, cost_estimate_usd (based on $0.29/M input, $1.65/M output), quality_score (placeholder 1-5)
4. Run same tasks against Claude Sonnet via Anthropic API for comparison
5. Output results to workspace/benchmarks/qwen36plus-benchmark-results.json
6. Include cost comparison table: monthly projected spend at 50 sessions/week

Requires env vars: QWEN_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. Skip Claude tests if ANTHROPIC_API_KEY not set.

tasks.context:
Create workspace/routing/cloud-tier-routing-rules.md documenting the CLOUD tier split:

# ClawRouter CLOUD Tier Routing Rules
## Date: 2026-04-03
## Source: TICKET-036 Workstream 7

### CLOUD-ORCHESTRATION (Claude Sonnet)
Routes here:
- CEO-level planning and multi-agent coordination
- PACT protocol negotiations (Chambers 1-5)
- User-facing responses and content generation
- Constitutional reasoning and governance decisions
- ACP scoring and codebook operations (vault-restricted)

### CLOUD-EXECUTION (Qwen 3.6-Plus API)
Routes here:
- Code generation (new files, new features)
- Agentic coding (plan → code → test → iterate loops)
- Repository-level engineering (multi-file changes)
- Bulk development tasks (batch file updates)
- Debug and fix tasks

### Vault Boundary
NEVER routes to CLOUD-EXECUTION:
- ACP scoring
- Codebook operations
- Financial reasoning with real data
- PACT credential handling
- Wallet key operations

### Cost Model
| Tier | Model | Input $/M | Output $/M | Monthly Est (50 sessions/week) |
|------|-------|-----------|------------|-------------------------------|
| CLOUD-ORCHESTRATION | Claude Sonnet | ~$3.00 | ~$15.00 | ~$XXX |
| CLOUD-EXECUTION | Qwen 3.6-Plus | ~$0.29 | ~$1.65 | ~$XXX |
| Savings | | | | ~XX% reduction |
